business: TROVE, an app to discover and book events and experiences in Johannesburg and Pretoria
target: People aged 21 to 35 in Johannesburg and Pretoria who go out at least a few times a month (comedy, events, sip-and-paint, adventure activities). All incomes and prices are in South African Rand, so read every $ as R

behaviours.name: Instagram discoverer
behaviours.how: Finds plans on Instagram and TikTok, then DMs or WhatsApps the venue or buys through the link in bio.

behaviours.name: Group organiser
behaviours.how: Plans outings for friends in a WhatsApp group and chases everyone to pay them back.

behaviours.name: Loyal to existing ticket apps
behaviours.how: Already buys event tickets on the platforms they know and trusts them.

behaviours.name: Spontaneous
behaviours.how: Decides on the day, often after 6pm, and pays at the door.

behaviours.name: Budget-conscious
behaviours.how: Watches every rand, hates extra fees, looks for free or cheap entry.

behaviours.name: Experience collector
behaviours.how: Saves up for one big experience a month, like skydiving or a tasting, and researches it carefully.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Will not book anything without reviews and photos from real people.

objections: Another app? I already buy tickets on the platforms I use
R8 on top of every booking adds up
Is my money safe with a brand-new app I've never heard of?
Why not just pay at the door or WhatsApp the venue?
What if the event gets cancelled? Will I actually get a refund?
There probably isn't much on it yet
Paying R5 to get my ticket on WhatsApp feels petty
habits: you live in Braamfontein and walk most places at night with friends
you work in Sandton and look for plans on Thursday for the weekend
you live in Pretoria East and drive everywhere
you are in a WhatsApp group of eight friends who go out together most weekends
you use data sparingly and only download apps you will use often
you go to a comedy show or a live event about twice a month
you take your partner on a planned date night every second Saturday
